title: A part's core has no row of its own on the Part Library list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with a Core Charge of $25.00, so it has a core.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Replace the search text with Core for followed by part A's description.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One entry is listed, with part A's description.

Step 2:

  • No entry is listed for the core.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-E3: “A core has no row of its own on the Inventory list, in Export or on the Part Library list, so it cannot be ticked for a bulk change. Its name (S13-R15) and its history show on the core's own Part History page. The core reason in S10-R13a applies when a core reaches a status change by any other route.”
